benchmark_type_evidence: we introduce BhashaBench V1, the first comprehensive domain-specific, multi-task, bilingual benchmark designed explicitly for evaluating large language models on India-centric knowledge systems
brief_description: BhashaBench V1 is a domain-specific, multi-task, bilingual (English and Hindi) benchmark containing 74,166 question-answer pairs across four India-centric domains: Agriculture, Legal, Finance, and Ayurveda. Questions are sourced from authentic government and professional examination papers, spanning 90+ subdomains and 500+ topics.
